COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE
                                  MINUTES

A meeting of the Committee of the Whole was held on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, in Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 6:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Tom Segrave, Council President and Chairman; Dr. Michelle
Aldrich; Dr. Kathy Emmons (via Zoom); Ken Esquibel; Pete Laybourn; Mark Moody; Dr. Mark
Rinne (via Zoom); Lawrence Wolfe; and Jeff White.


                                     AGENDA ITEMS

13.    ORDINANCE       —


                          2’ READING      —    Appropriating moneys for the City of Cheyenne,
       Wyoming for the various purposes in conducting the Municipal Government of said city
       and fixing the arnount of General and Special Taxes as part of the revenue required to meet
       the said appropriation, all for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2026, and ending June 30,
       2027. (SPONSOR MR. SEGRAVE)
                           -




Dr Aldrich moved to approve on 2” reading, seconded by Mr. White.

Dr. Aldrich moved to amend the Police Administration Division Fund by increasing it by a total
of $80,875.00 (regular employees by $42,169.00, health insurance by $29,815.00, life insurance
by $42.00, public employees’ pension by $6,376.00, worker’s compensation by $773.00, and
FICA by $2,928.00) to hire an additional Community Service Officer and decrease the City
Council Division General Discretionary Fund by the same amount seconded by Mr. Esquibel.
Motion to amend carried with members Aldrich, Emmons, Esquibel, Layboum, Moody and White
voting “YES” and Rinne, Segrave, and Wolfe voting “NO.”

Mr. Moody moved to amend by increasing the Miscellaneous Division Transfer to Other Funds
expenditure line item by $100,000.00 and decreasing the City Council Division General
Discretionary Fund expenditure line item by the same amount. Mr. Moody further moved to
amend the Fleet Maintenance Fund budget by increasing the Equipment Expenditure line item by
$100,000.00 and increasing the transfer from Other Funds Revenue line item by the same amount.
Motion to amend was seconded by Mr. White. Motion to amend failed with members Aldrich,
Emmons, Laybourn, Rinne Segrave, White and Wolfe voting “NO” and Esquibel and Moody
voting “YES.”

Mr. Moody moved to amend the General Fund fiscal year 2027 budget to eliminate the proposed
new GIS Technician I position within the City Engineer Division by $103,083.00 and increase the
Miscellaneous Division Transfer to Reserves expenditure line item by the same amount, seconded
by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to amend failed with all members voting “NO” except for Mr. Moody
who voted “YES.”

Main motion, as amended, carried with all members voting “YES” except for Mr. Moody who
voted “NO.”
